meta.title: Avalon online game nights · Trust no one at the round table
meta.description: Avalon is a game of hidden roles, bold lies, and one perfect betrayal. Draw your role card, share it with friends, and ask us on WhatsApp about the next online night.

hero.title: Trust *no one* at the round table.

how.title: Three rounds of *doubt.*
how.lede: New to Avalon? You will have it in two minutes. The rest is reading faces.
how.step1Body: Loyal knight or hidden traitor. Only you know which.
how.step2Body: Teams are picked, votes are cast, and every choice says something about you.
how.step3Title: Find the traitors before they win
how.step3Body: Three failed quests and evil takes the throne. Talk, accuse, bluff.

deal.title: Ten seats. Six are loyal. Four are *lying.*
deal.lede: Every player gets one secret card. Nobody shows it. Not even to friends.

night.title: Night falls. Everyone knows something different.
night.others: Everyone else saw nothing at all.

sees.merlin: Sees the Assassin, Morgana and Oberon as evil. Cannot see Mordred.
sees.assassin: Knows Morgana and Mordred. Does not know Oberon.
sees.morgana: Knows the Assassin and Mordred. Looks like Merlin to Percival.
sees.mordred: Knows the Assassin and Morgana. Merlin cannot see him.
sees.oberon: Knows nobody. Oberon is alone in the dark.
sees.percival: Sees two cards that could be Merlin: Merlin and Morgana. Cannot tell which is real.

seen.merlin: Seen by Percival, who thinks he may be Merlin.
seen.assassin: Seen by Merlin, Morgana and Mordred.
seen.morgana: Seen by Merlin, the Assassin, Mordred and Percival.
seen.mordred: Seen by the Assassin and Morgana. Merlin cannot see him.

vote.title: The vote
vote.team1: The leader picks who goes on the quest.
vote.cards: Every player holds two cards: Approve and Reject.
vote.all: Everyone votes. All at once. In the open.
vote.five: Five rejected teams in a row,
vote.fiveSub: and evil wins without lifting a blade.
vote.how2: Every player lays one vote card face down.
vote.how3: All the cards are turned over at once.
vote.how4: More than half must Approve for the team to go.
vote.how6: Five rejected teams in a row, and evil wins.

quest.title: The quest
quest.secret: The team goes on the quest. In secret.
quest.rule: The loyal must play Success. Traitors may play either.
quest.q1: Even the Assassin plays Success. For now.
quest.team2: A new leader. A team of four. Approved.
quest.hand: Only you see it. The Assassin picks Fail.
quest.shuffle: Shuffled. Nobody can follow which is which.
quest.fail: One Fail is enough. Nobody knows whose.
quest.cardLabel: Quest card {n} of 4, face down. Turn it over.
quest.r1: Quest 1: three cards, all Success. The quest succeeds.
quest.r2: Quest 2: four cards, one Fail. The quest fails.
quest.how1: Each player on the team plays one card, face down.
quest.how2: The loyal must play Success. Traitors may play either.
quest.how3: The cards are shuffled before they are turned.
quest.how4: One Fail and the quest fails (quest 4 at seven players or more needs two).

draw.title: Which side are *you* on?
draw.lede: Seven cards, face down. Tap once and fate deals you a role. Share it and see what your friends get.
draw.noscript: The card draw needs JavaScript. You can still ask us anything on WhatsApp.

share.text: I drew {role} at the Avalon round table. Which role will you get?

final.title: Your seat is *waiting.*
final.lede: Online Avalon nights. Come alone or bring your group. We fill the table.

footer.note: Original artwork. Not an official product of any game publisher.

rolePage.title: {role}. *Which one are you?*
rolePage.tail: Seven roles, one table, and nobody is who they say they are.
rolePage.metaDescription: A friend drew {role}. {line} Draw your own role and join an online Avalon night.

notFound.title: This seat is *empty.*
notFound.body: The page you are looking for is not at the table.

waMessage.general: Hi! I want to know more about the online Avalon game nights.
waMessage.withRole: Hi! I drew {role} on your Avalon page. Tell me more about the online game nights.
waMessage.seat: Hi! Save me a seat at the next online Avalon night.

merlin.name: Merlin
merlin.line: Knows who is evil, but must never be found out.
merlin.drawLine: You know every traitor at the table. Guide the loyal without giving yourself away.

percival.name: Percival
percival.line: Knows Merlin, and must shield him from the Assassin.
percival.drawLine: You know who Merlin is, or you think you do. Protect him to the very end.

loyal-servant.name: Loyal Servant
loyal-servant.line: No special knowledge. Just sharp eyes and a loyal heart.
loyal-servant.drawLine: No secrets and no powers. Only your wits to tell friend from traitor.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.line: If good wins the quests, one strike at Merlin can still steal the game.
assassin.drawLine: Lose the quests and you still get one strike. Name Merlin and evil takes it all.

morgana.name: Morgana
morgana.line: Poses as Merlin to mislead Percival.
morgana.drawLine: You pose as Merlin and send the loyal down the wrong path. Can you keep a straight face?

mordred.name: Mordred
mordred.line: The one traitor even Merlin cannot see.
mordred.drawLine: Even Merlin cannot see you. Hide in plain sight and pull the strings.

oberon.name: Oberon
oberon.line: Evil, but alone. The other traitors do not know him.
oberon.drawLine: You are evil and nobody knows it, not even your own side. Cause chaos alone.

peek.hint: Tap anywhere to put the card back

lady.title: The Lady of the Lake
lady.name: Lady of the Lake
lady.wakes: After the second quest, the Lady of the Lake wakes.
lady.looks: He looks at seat 3, the one the table blames.
lady.still: The table turns to still water.
lady.shows: She shows her holder one player's true side.
lady.merlin: Even Merlin can't see this lie.
lady.merlinWhy: Merlin sees three traitors. Mordred is not one of them.
lady.again: She wakes again after quests 3 and 4.
lady.poolLabel: The Lady's water. Touch it to see seat 3's true side.
lady.result: Mordred saw that seat 3 is loyal, and told the table seat 3 is evil.
lady.how1: After quests 2, 3 and 4, whoever holds the Lady chooses one player.
lady.how2: They secretly see that player's side, loyal or evil, but not the role.
lady.how3: They may tell the table the truth or lie.
lady.how4: Then they hand the Lady to that player.
lady.how5: Someone who has already held the Lady can't be chosen.

climb.title: The climb
climb.q3cards: Even Morgana plays Success. She needs their trust.
climb.ladyAgain: The Lady wakes again. Seat 3 looks at the Assassin.
climb.q4lead: Percival leads. He trusts the wrong Merlin.
climb.q4rule: At ten players, quest four needs two Fails.
climb.ladyOnce: She wakes once more. The Assassin looks at Percival, and says nothing.
climb.q5lead: Seat 6 leads. Percival names the team.
climb.liveRed: Red. The Assassin is evil, and seat 3 tells the truth.
climb.r3: Quest 3 succeeded: four cards, all Success.
climb.rLady: Seat 3 looked at the Assassin, saw red, and told the truth.
climb.r4: Quest 4 failed with two Fail cards, from Morgana and Mordred.
climb.r5: Quest 5 succeeded: five cards, all Success. Loyal win, three quests to two.
climb.how1: The first side to win three quests wins.
climb.how2: The leader moves one seat to the left after every team, approved or not.
climb.how3: At seven players or more, quest 4 needs two Fail cards to fail.
climb.how4: The Lady of the Lake wakes after quests 2, 3 and 4.

seat.friend: Now imagine the liar is your best friend.

blade.title: The blade
blade.evilWin: Evil can lose every quest and still win.
blade.name: Name Merlin, and everything goes to evil.
blade.percival: All game, Percival played Merlin to draw the blade.
blade.saw: You saw everything tonight. The Assassin saw nothing.
blade.hintMouse: Point at a card, then click.
blade.hintTouch: Tap to aim. Tap again to strike.
blade.lost: Three quests won. One name lost it all.
blade.saved: The blade missed. The realm is saved.
blade.liveA: The blade found Merlin. Evil wins.
blade.liveB: The blade missed. {name} was loyal, not Merlin. The realm is saved.
blade.orScroll: Or keep scrolling, and the Assassin chooses.
blade.plainA: The Assassin named Merlin. Evil wins.
blade.plainB: The Assassin named seat {n}, {name}. Good wins.
blade.popTitle: Select the card you think is Merlin.
blade.popNote: (If you don't choose, Good wins by default.)
blade.popNote2: Choose correctly and you win the game and make a comeback.
blade.how1: If the loyal win three quests, the game is not over.
blade.how2: The Assassin gets one guess: he names the player he thinks is Merlin.
blade.how3: If he is right, evil wins the whole game. If he is wrong, the loyal win.
